profile.headline: Software Engineer | Security Clearance | Bilingual | Veteran |Tech 💻 & Science 🧬 Enthusiast
profile.summary: Software Engineer and US Army veteran with a passion for technology and problem-solving. Highly adaptable, solution-driven, and always on the lookout for improvement. Experience working with multiple software development technologies and always eager to learn more.

positions.title: Software Engineer | Full-Stack
positions.description:
•	Designed, built, and maintained web applications, focusing on user experience and Artificial Intelligence (AI) integration.
•	Utilized scripting languages, management tools, and digital media to enhance application functionality.
•	Collaborated with teams to resolve conflicts, prioritize tasks, and develop content criteria for optimal solutions.
•	Updated and directed web application improvements, ensuring compatibility with various browsers and devices.
•	Developed and validated test routines and schedules to mimic external interfaces and address user needs.
•	Stayed updated with the latest web applications and programming practices through continuous education and participation in conferences and workshops.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
•	Developed custom modules to meet client needs and specifications.
•	Converted legacy SQL, VB.Net, and JS procedures from their old system to work with their new environment.
•	Worked on data input and workflow management system geared towards State Government agencies to assist them in managing their Grant Management Processes. The system uses a robust database which we use Microsoft SQL to interact with. The web base is a mix of ASP.NET MVC, VB.NET 4.6.2, JavaScript, HTML 5, and others.

positions.title: Team Lead - Non-Commissioned Officer
positions.description:
•	Manages the daily operations of a team of 6 military multichannel system operators.
•	Established secure and reliable lines of communication by configuring various types of satellites and antennas to achieve connection between distant locations through efficient collaboration. 
•	Troubleshooting and repairs on multi-channel transmission systems and any assigned support equipment.
•	Maintains the operational readiness of electrical, computer, and communication systems valued at over $1 million.

positions.title: Communications Specialist
positions.description: Supervise, install, operate, and perform unit-level maintenance on multichannel line-of-site and tropospheric scatter communications systems, communications security (COMSEC) devices, and associated equipment.

positions.title: Microsoft Software and Systems Academy - Cloud Applications Developer
positions.description:
Software Engineering immersive program with a focus on cloud application development.
    ▪ Software development with C# (.NET).
    ▪ Web development using HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript.
    ▪ Unit and integration testing to validate solutions with ASP.NET projects.
    ▪ Designing and building applications using Azure Cloud Solutions, T-SQL, and the ASP.NET framework.

projects.title: Playas Limpias Web Application - ASP.NET
projects.description: A volunteer-based coast rescue web application. The application will show all current events with their details, events that the user is actively volunteering and has volunteered for in the past, provide the ability to set reminders for upcoming events, and create custom events to allow other users to volunteer.

projects.title: Mobile Application for WGU University - Concept
projects.description: A multiple-screen mobile application for WGU students to track their academic terms, courses associated with each term, and assessments associated with each course. The application allows students to enter, edit, and delete a term, course, and assessment data. It provides a summary and detailed views of courses for each term, provides notifications for upcoming performance and objective assessments, and notifies students of deadlines and tracking milestones even after the application is closed. A wireframe has also been created as a visual guide, representing the skeletal framework of the application. The application uses an SQLite database.

organizations.name: The National Society of Leadership and Success
organizations.description:
Selected by campus administration to participate among top students in a leadership program including:

Leadership Training Day: Trained in leadership and success skills via an introspective and interactive training session.
Speaker Events: Participated in seminars led by celebrities and best-selling authors on topics such as leadership, time management, and goal setting.
Success Networking Teams:
Participated in peer-based leadership development teams
Experience in setting and achieving goals, receiving coaching, coaching others, and holding others accountable to commitments.
